title: Immunization Services Pharmacist Chart - Doses Still Needed After an Invalidation Entry
content:
**Immunization Services: the count an invalidation entry restates.**

> The restated count is the course's valid doses still needed as the course shows them before the entry, plus the one dose the entry takes off, and it is never below zero nor above the valid doses the course requires.

### Terms used in this chart

- **Valid doses the course requires**: the number of valid doses that complete the course, as the course record carries it.
- **Valid doses still needed before the entry**: the count the course record shows at the moment the invalidation entry is booked, before any change.
- **Restated count**: the valid doses still needed that the invalidation entry sets on the course.

### How the restated count is formed

1. Take the valid doses still needed as the course shows them before the entry.
2. Add one, for the dose the entry takes off.
3. Hold the figure between zero and the valid doses the course requires: a figure above the required doses becomes the required doses; a figure below zero becomes zero.

### Chart (hypothetical courses)

| Valid doses the course requires | Still needed before the entry | Before one is added back | Restated count |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 0 plus one is 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 0 | 0 plus one is 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 plus one is 2 | 2 |
| 2 | 2 | 2 plus one is 3, above the 2 required | 2 |
| 3 | 0 | 0 plus one is 1 | 1 |
| 3 | 1 | 1 plus one is 2 | 2 |
| 3 | 2 | 2 plus one is 3 | 3 |

### Worked example (hypothetical)

A three-dose course shows 1 valid dose still needed when the entry is booked. One added back for the dose the entry takes off gives 2; 2 lies between zero and the 3 required doses, so the restated count is 2.

### Boundary on the ceiling (hypothetical)

A two-dose course already showing 2 valid doses still needed would reach 3 once one is added back. The count is never above the valid doses the course requires, so it is held at 2.
